name: Flip the tower
author: yeger00
notes: Both players need the same two-crate tower, one after the other. White lifts a black crate to the ceiling and slides it to the wall; Black slides the other one under it, climbs on, and bumps the top one down onto it. White holds plate c so Black can jump from the tower up through the hatch. Then White flips the tower to the ceiling, top crate first, and Black holds plate d so White can jump down through the trapdoor. Plate d before the flip drops the tower; plate c after it floats the tower away.
